english: For $t\in[1,5]$, let $A(t)$ denote the area of the region bounded by the curve $y=x^{3}$, the tangent to this curve at the point $(t,t^{3})$, and the lines $x=0$ and $x=6$. If $M$ and $m$ are the greatest and the least values of $A(t)$ on $[1,5]$, respectively, then the value of $M+m$ is ______.
hindi: $t\in[1,5]$ के लिए, माना कि $A(t)$ वक्र $y=x^{3}$, इस वक्र के बिन्दु $(t,t^{3})$ पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा, तथा रेखाओं $x=0$ एवं $x=6$ द्वारा परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है। यदि $[1,5]$ पर $A(t)$ के महत्तम तथा न्यूनतम मान क्रमशः $M$ तथा $m$ हैं, तो $M+m$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Tangent: $y=3t^{2}x-2t^{3}$; $x^{3}-(3t^{2}x-2t^{3})=(x-t)^{2}(x+2t)\ge 0$ for $x\ge 0$ (the other meeting point $-2t$ is outside $[0,6]$), so the curve stays above the tangent.
solution_full: Curve minus tangent: $x^{3}-3t^{2}x+2t^{3}=(x-t)^{2}(x+2t)$. For $t\in[1,5]$ and $x\in[0,6]$, $x+2t>0$, so the difference is $\ge 0$, zero only at $x=t$: the curve lies above the tangent throughout the strip and the region is well defined.
Least value: $m=A(3)=324-486+324=162$ (the tangent at the midpoint of the strip).
Greatest value on the closed interval is at an end point: $A(1)=324-54+12=282$, $A(5)=324-1350+1500=474$. So $M=474$.
originality_note: New: the area between y = x^3 and a moving tangent over a fixed strip [0,6], a cubic function of the contact point whose minimum is at the midpoint and whose maximum on [1,5] is at an end point (way 2, a function defined by a construction). Closest known: least area between a parabola and its tangent over a fixed interval (tangent at the midpoint). Different because: the curve is a cubic, the region needs the check that -2t is outside the strip, and the greatest value on the closed interval comes from comparing end values.

concept_use.Maximum or minimum of an area expressed: A(t) = 324 - 54t^2 + 12t^3 is the area as a function of the contact abscissa t; its least value is at t = 3.
concept_use.Greatest and least value of a function i: On the closed interval [1,5] the greatest value is found by comparing the end values A(1) = 282 and A(5) = 474 with the critical value.

stem_review: Read as a student: every function and curve introduced with its domain, every condition stated, one reading, answer unique and equal to the plan; Hindi mirrors the English maths. Checked that the curve lies above the tangent on the whole strip for every t in [1,5], so A(t) has one reading. No change.
key_step: Write A(t) as a cubic in t and compare its critical value with the end values on [1,5].
justification: Area as a function of a parameter, then closed-interval extrema with end-point comparison; two ideas linked, numerical. L3, a step above 2023-P2-Q9 (L2, DE then maximum).
